headline: Mansehra Assistant Commissioner Adil Waseem was injured on Saturday when unknown gunmen opened fire at his official vehicle in Panah Kot, Nowshera district, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa; a hospital spokesperson said he is stable, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Mansehra AC Adil Waseem zakhmi, hospital ke mutabiq halat stable.

caption:
Nowshera mein Mansehra AC ki gari par firing!
Dawn ke mutabiq Saturday ko Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ke district Nowshera ke ilaqe Panah Kot mein namaloom afraad ne Mansehra ke Assistant Commissioner Adil Waseem ki sarkari gari par firing ki, jis mein woh zakhmi ho gaye. Lady Reading Hospital ke spokesperson ke mutabiq un ki halat stable hai, aur Nowshera DPO Sonia Shamroz ke mutabiq ilaqe ko gher kar search operation shuru kar diya gaya hai.
KP mein aman ke liye kya hona chahiye? Comment mein batayein 👇
